newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba denies seeking investment in Samsung unit.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba denies seeking investment in Samsung unit.

text.p: Toshiba Corp on Wednesday denied a newspaper report that it was planning to invest in a U.S. unit of South Korea's Samsung Electronics Co and said it was not negotiating with Samsung over a possible equities tie-up.
"We deny the report," a Toshiba spokesman said, referring to a report in the Nihon Keizai Shimbun, a Japanese economic daily.
"There is no plan for an equities tie-up. We are not negotiating and we did not reach any agreement," he said.
The Nihon Keizai said on Wednesday that Toshiba would purchase a 20 percent stake in Samsung Austin Semiconductor Inc which would manage a chip plant Samsung Electronics is constructing in Texas.
It also said Toshiba would receive 20 percent of the 64-megabit dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips the plant will produce, the paper said.
